Subject: The same friendly parent and curious child as the supplied reference, seated together observing a potted leafy plant. Preserve the parent's round glasses, loose dark hair bun and pale blue shirt, the child's short tousled dark hair and pale yellow shirt, the small magnifying glass near a leaf, pointing gesture, complete figures and plant. Keep the same scene and characters while translating the entire drawing into this style's own medium. One coherent isolated group, no room or surrounding slide.
Style: Refined editorial 16-bit pixel illustration of expressive everyday people, objects or a compact local situation. Crisp square pixel clusters on a consistent grid, stepped silhouettes, carefully placed limited-palette highlights and shadows, dark navy pixel outlines, readable expressive faces and interesting small details. Blue, coral and warm natural skin colors. Apparent subject resolution about 160–200 pixels high enlarged with nearest-neighbor crisp edges. The subject itself must be pixel art, not a smooth cartoon inside a pixel frame. NO blur, smooth vector curves, paper fibers, tape, card, castle, game level, map, adventure, quest, HUD or in-image text. Isolated complete subject on genuine transparency.
Palette: #172033, #1688f8, #de3e49, #a7c9ed, #edbc96.
Keep the entire subject intact with generous clear margin. Use a genuinely transparent background.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, captions, arrows, labels or surrounding slide. Text and relationships will be rendered separately.
Use supplied references for drawing style and consistent subject appearance; do not copy their text or background.
